bucket.name: opal-313476888478-terraform-state

function.name: auth-validator-edge
function.role: JWT gate at CloudFront viewer layer. Validates Bearer token before CloudFront forwards to origin.
function.note: Dynamic ARN since portal-auth v1.14.0 — auto-bumps on every apply. Resolves the v12-pin incident (2026-04-15).

function.name: shared-advisor-router
function.role: Routes BD advisor-intelligence origin requests to firm-scoped S3 keys.

function.name: public-data-router
function.role: Rewrites yang data origin requests to correct S3 key paths.

function.name: cache-control-injector
function.role: Injects cache-control headers on yang data origin responses.

lambda.name: opalinvest-auth-handler
lambda.role: Portal auth handler — JWT verification, Cognito token flow, session management.

lambda.name: opal-portal-authorizer
lambda.role: JWT verification authorizer for portal API Gateway — Phase 1 Foundation. Note: NOT a Lambda@Edge function despite the name; auth-validator-edge is the CloudFront gate.

cognito_pool.status: NOT DISCOVERABLE from local source files. Pool ID consumed via environment variables or Secrets Manager. Not declared in any Terraform module.

auth_infrastructure.jwt_flow_summary: Portal frontend stores Cognito access token in localStorage (key: accessToken). All API calls include Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}. Optional X-Api-Key from VITE_PORTAL_API_KEY. auth-validator-edge validates at CloudFront viewer-request before forwarding to origin. Token refresh handled by AuthContext in the portal.

table.name: opal-partner-49financial
table.purpose: Per-partner identity bridge joining portal users to BD gold layer advisor identity (advisorKey, advisorRole). Auth-handler reads at login to inject advisor claims into JWT.

table.name: causality-generations
table.purpose: Generation records from causality-market-update-generator. Empty at import.

table.name: causality-saved-analyses

table.name: opal-pii-lookup
table.purpose: Schwab anonymizer PII lookup table. 5,611 items / 757 KB at import. Live traffic.

table.name: opal-sessions
table.purpose: Session store. 3.2M items / 1.8 GB. Every portal login writes here.

table.name: user-permissions

table.purpose: Legacy user table (12 items). Also exists in us-east-2; only us-east-1 imported.

issue.title: opal-cloudfront-market-generator — unregistered function
issue.detail: portal-notifications/main.tf registers S3 trigger + Lambda permission, but function NOT in lambda-source-map.json. Source directory, TF module, and deployment state unknown. S3 trigger silently fails if function does not exist in AWS.
issue.action: Locate or create source. Register in lambda-source-map.json. Add TF resource. Verify in AWS console.

issue.title: opal-users-v2 dual-declared in two TF modules
issue.detail: aws_dynamodb_table.opal_users_v2 appears in both shared-infra/dynamo.tf (DEBT_1STRUN.005, 2026-04-13) and portal-auth/dynamodb.tf (CDRS_TFIMPT.006, 2026-04-15). Only one module can own the TF state resource. The other will conflict on plan/apply.
issue.action: Run terraform state list in both modules. Whichever owns the state is canonical. Remove the declaration from the other module (or replace with data source). Requires coordinated apply.

issue.title: ec2-auto-shutdown-enforcer, cost-anomaly-scanner, access-anomaly-scanner — not found
issue.detail: Expected monitoring Lambda functions absent from lambda-source-map.json. No source directories in repo. May be planned but not yet created.
issue.action: Verify in AWS Lambda console. Register if they exist or remove from scope documentation.

issue.title: ORNREN.002 — inf-gold-layer-runner dispatch_script references inf-gold-dispatch.sh
issue.detail: EC2_MANIFEST.json dispatch_script for inf-gold-layer-runner is still inf-gold-dispatch.sh. ORNREN.001 (DS) will rename scripts; ORNREN.002 (AE) will update the manifest. Gated on ORNREN.001 MCP signal.
issue.action: Execute ORNREN.002 on receipt of "ORNREN.001 DS complete — S3 MATCH confirmed" MCP from DS~A. Update dispatch_script to orion-gold-dispatch.sh.
